name: DeepSeek API
description: Serves DeepSeek models through OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs with thinking mode, tool calls, JSON output, and context caching, for developers using existing SDKs.

skills.name: Thinking Mode
skills.description: Enables model reasoning before the answer, with adjustable reasoning effort.

skills.name: Tool Calls
skills.description: Lets models call functions you define and return structured arguments.

skills.name: JSON Output
skills.description: Constrains responses to valid JSON for machine-readable results.

skills.name: Anthropic API Compatibility
skills.description: Accepts Anthropic-format requests at a dedicated base URL so Anthropic SDKs work unchanged.

skills.name: Context Caching
skills.description: Caches repeated prompt prefixes to reduce cost and latency on later requests.
